findings.title: `carry` makes any review row, a 🔴 included, vanish with no task and no record
A 🔴 row escapes the coverage check when the table is off-shape, has no Ref column, or uses bullets
`review-close` applies a batch whose findings table `gate` refuses as unreadable
`--batch-id tail-sweep` works as a full decision gate with no coverage check, and can double the rework
An empty tail sweep applies and blocks the real one
`review-stage` reuses an old green record even when told to run a different gate command, or a forged one
`gate --findings` passes a findings file that `review-close` then refuses, with a vague message
The phase-delegation hook misses many everyday wordings
Moving a source file into the store tree reuses a stale green test record
`gate.py` and `__main__.py` help text still describe the pre-00264 check
`review-close` and `group-rework` grow cubically with distinct files, inside the state lock
A tail sweep accepts a finding the decision gate already deferred
Uncovered rows are reported one per round trip, and the error never mentions `carry`
The tail-sweep output reports lenses as closed when it wrote none
The 0.9.0 and checkout findings formats are incompatible whenever a `[C]` re-queue exists
With `--repo-root` below the git toplevel, the gate record is never reused
A reviewer missing from `agents:` is logged as a successful dispatch while its lens is marked failed
A verification record whose sha is `HEAD` is reused forever
An interactive full review diffs against master's tip, not the branch point; a bad `--since` is dropped silently
A repeated `already applied` call overwrites `state.json.bak`
The delegation hook crashes on a non-UTF-8 or deeply nested payload instead of failing open cleanly
State `prd` with `../` and an absolute `design_doc` read any file into reviewer inputs
`review-stage` follows a symlinked `docs/dev/tmp` and writes outside the repo
`dispatch_rows:` ids that start with `-` are parsed as options by `record_dispatch`
The `gate --findings` mismatch pass is quadratic
The 0.9.0 changelog has no line for the launch-prompt coreutils ban
The worker-tier tools fix shipped in 0.8.0 with no changelog line
Two rework-groups fixes shipped in 0.9.0 with no 0.9.0 line
The `[Unreleased]` line omits the tail-sweep exemption and what `carry` does
`phase-review.md:280` is silent on `carry`
Root `plugin.json` says 0.1.0, and the README counts are stale
The release gate never runs five test modules, including the one that validates the 00264 classification list
